shard_unit: one training seed = all matched arms x all tasks x all conditions x all scenes

proposal.torch: last 2 training seeds in GPU02 queue order (about 2/3 of the matrix); must be never-attempted at ack time
proposal.gpu02: all remaining seeds, including every cell already complete, failed or in flight
proposal.torch_hardware: L40S only (sm_89); H200 only as a whole-shard switch if L40S cannot start
proposal.torch_concurrency: Historical proposal only; current cap is 2 GPUs subject to actual verified available QOS and allocation.

effective_when: No longer effective; only verified transfer in coordination/gpu02-eval-assist-20261001 registry.json changes ownership.
assets_needed_on_torch: Exact assets must be verified through a user-authorized delivery channel; this record grants no new publication authorization.
release_rule: No timeout-based reassignment; follow protocol v1 and original Oct 2 deadline, never Oct 3.
failures: retained, never auto-retried; technical failures reported separately
reporting: per-episode ledger with task id, checkpoint sha256, source version, GPU/PyTorch/CUDA, seed/scene/condition, native success, steps, time, technical failure; analysis on valid matched cells with machine/hardware labels
historical_user_decision_claim: 2026-10-01: split the new-checkpoint evaluation between GPU02 and Torch; no separate private handoff; coordinate via this progress branch
authorization_note: Historical proposal text is not authorization to publish private research assets.
